pending_part_2.description: PART 2 (FINALE): Modern forensic science finally uncovers why the Mary Celeste crew fled. #shorts #viral #mystery
pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we saw the baffling abandonment of the Mary Celeste in the open Atlantic. For over a century, theories blamed sea monsters, mutiny, or alien abductions. But modern chemical forensics and pressure chamber experiments at Oxford University uncovered a chillingly plausible explanation. The ship was transporting seventeen hundred barrels of raw denatured alcohol. Nine barrels were discovered completely empty and ruptured. Scientists proved that shifting cargo caused leaking alcohol vapors to ignite in the confined hold, triggering a sudden, deafening pressure wave without leaving scorch marks. Convinced the ship was about to explode into a fireball, the panicked captain ordered everyone into the small lifeboat on a trailing rope. When a sudden Atlantic squall snapped the line, the Mary Celeste sailed away forever.
